include(FetchContent)
set(CMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0077 NEW)

add_subdirectory(DataContainerGenerator)
add_subdirectory(DataContainerLuaGenerator)
add_subdirectory(DataContainerOOSReporter)
add_subdirectory(catch2)
if (NOT ANDROID)
	# GLEW e um carregador de extensoes do OpenGL de desktop -- no Android as funcoes
	# GLES vem direto do sistema (libGLESv3). Ver src/graphics/android_gl/glew.h
	add_subdirectory(glew)
endif()
add_subdirectory(stb)
add_subdirectory(glm)
add_subdirectory(freetype)
add_subdirectory(luajit)
if (NOT WIN32)
	if (ANDROID)
		add_subdirectory(simde)
	else()
		# GLFW nao suporta Android (nao ha X11/Wayland/Cocoa la) -- a janela/contexto
		# no Android vem do NativeActivity + EGL (ver src/window/window_android.cpp)
		add_subdirectory(glfw)
	endif()
	add_subdirectory(miniaudio)
	add_subdirectory(tbb)
	add_subdirectory(icu)
	add_subdirectory(fmt)
endif()
